channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-123158 — OpenBSD OpenSSH
item.description: Threat Signal 81. OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

item.title: CVE-2026-116606 — Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG)
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

item.title: CVE-2026-111560 — Barracuda Networks Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606

item.title: CVE-2024-21410 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2016-3976 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 72. SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a directory traversal vulnerability via a ..\ (dot dot backslash) in the fileName parameter to CrashFileDownloadServlet. This allows remote attackers to read files.

item.title: CVE-2026-116779 — SignalWire FreeSwitch
item.description: Threat Signal 76. SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-49869 — Kestra Kestra OSS
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-48356 — Adobe Commerce and Magento
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

item.title: CVE-2026-40217 — BerriAI LiteLLM
item.description: Threat Signal 81. BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

item.title: CVE-2026-19868 — SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN
item.description: Threat Signal 64. SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

item.title: CVE-2026-104935 — Ivanti Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-102895 — GPUStack GPUStack
item.description: Threat Signal 71. GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

item.title: CVE-2026-90817 — Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash.

item.title: CVE-2026-114625 — Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

item.title: CVE-2025-6218 — RARLAB WinRAR
item.description: Threat Signal 78. RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2026-76418 — Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

item.title: CVE-2026-119977 — WordPress WordPress Core
item.description: Threat Signal 65. WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

item.title: CVE-2026-111497 — Google Brotli
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

item.title: CVE-2026-96652 — Plex Media Server
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

item.title: CVE-2026-102764 — BeyondTrust Remote Support
item.description: Threat Signal 74. BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

item.title: CVE-2024-10441 — Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM)
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

item.title: CVE-2026-90436 — Apache Axis
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

item.title: CVE-2026-129448 — Apache Roller
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.

item.title: CVE-2026-123890 — Broadcom VMware vCenter
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

item.title: CVE-2026-97229 — GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 82. GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

item.title: CVE-2023-46748 — F5 BIG-IP Configuration Utility
item.description: Threat Signal 59. F5 BIG-IP Configuration utility contains an SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with network access through the BIG-IP management port and/or self IP addresses to execute system commands. This vulnerability can be used in conjunction with CVE-2023-46747.

item.title: CVE-2023-32049 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Microsoft Windows Defender SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass the Open File - Security Warning prompt.

item.title: CVE-2021-29256 — Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU)
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to gain root privilege and/or disclose information.

item.title: CVE-2016-0165 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2010-3904 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Linux Kernel contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Reliable Datagram Sockets (RDS) protocol implementation that allows local users to gain privileges via crafted use of the sendmsg and recvmsg system calls.

item.title: CVE-2022-39197 — Fortra Cobalt Strike
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Fortra Cobalt Strike contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Teamserver that would allow an attacker to set a malformed username in the Beacon configuration, allowing them to execute code remotely.

item.title: CVE-2020-3837 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS contain a memory corruption vulnerability that could allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.

item.title: CVE-2019-15271 — Cisco RV Series Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 59. A deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the web-based management interface of certain Cisco Small Business RV Series Routers could allow an attacker to execute code with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2015-0310 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Adobe Flash Player does not properly restrict discovery of memory addresses, which allows attackers to bypass the address space layout randomization (ASLR) protection mechanism.

item.title: CVE-2021-30883 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Apple iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS contain a memory corruption vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-7286 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Apple iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS contain a memory corruption vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2022-26486 — Mozilla Firefox
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Mozilla Firefox contains a use-after-free vulnerability in WebGPU IPC Framework which can be exploited to perform arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-20708 — Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 59. A vulnerability in Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers could allow an attacker to do any of the following: Execute arbitrary code elevate privileges, execute arbitrary commands, bypass authentication and authorization protections, fetch and run unsigned software, or cause a denial of service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2018-0167 — Cisco IOS, XR, and XE Software
item.description: Threat Signal 59. There is a buffer overflow vulnerability in the Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) subsystem of Cisco IOS Software, Cisco IOS XE Software, and Cisco IOS XR Software which could allow an unauthenticated, adjacent attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) condition or execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2017-6744 — Cisco IOS software
item.description: Threat Signal 59. The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS 1 contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code on an affected system or cause an affected system to reload. An attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by sending a crafted SNMP packet to an affected system via IPv4 or IPv6.

item.title: CVE-2008-3431 — Oracle VirtualBox
item.description: Threat Signal 59. An input validation vulnerability exists in the VBoxDrv.sys driver of Sun xVM VirtualBox which allows attackers to locally execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2021-30661 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and Safari WebKit Storage contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-30666 — Apple iOS
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Apple iOS WebKit contains a buffer-overflow vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-30665 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS WebKit contain a memory corruption vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-30663 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and Safari WebKit contain an integer overflow vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-28664 — Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU)
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) kernel driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to gain write access to read-only memory, gain root privilege, corrupt memory, and modify the memory of other processes.

item.title: CVE-2020-16013 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an inappropriate implementation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2021-30554 — Google Chromium WebGL
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Google Chromium WebGL contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2020-0878 — Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer contain a memory corruption vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2020-0986 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Microsoft Windows kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability when handling objects in memory that allows attackers to escalate privileges and execute code in kernel mode.
